messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — planning a compact office hours for Account: HelioHealth next Wed. 30m slot 9:30–10:00am PT. Goal: onboarding checklist walkthrough + quick renewal health scan. Who can facilitate and who can take notes?

Ethan: I can run the onboarding checklist portion. Can we trim the live demo to ~10m so we stay within 30m? :+1:

Jules: I have a calendar conflict 9:30–10:00 but can swap with someone or take notes if we move to 10:00. Prefer not to miss the renewal bits.

María: I can cover renewal risks and escalation signals (5–8m). 9:30 works for me. I will prepare 3 bullets on current health and red flags.

Priya (CS): Perfect — plan: Ethan = onboarding checklist, María = renewal risks. Need a note-taker and someone to create the invite + agenda doc. @onboarding-bot can you create the event with agenda skeleton and attach the runbook?

onboarding-bot: Created event -> https://cal.example.com/event/5332109876. Agenda skeleton added to the calendar description and doc: https://redwood.docs/compact-office-hours-template.ics. Runbook snippet copied to /docs/onboard/compact-office-hours-template.

Ethan: I added slide notes to the doc and a short checklist snippet. Quick question — should we pre-send a 2-item pre-read to the customer (current hitlist + migration checklist)? I think that will make Q&A faster.

María: Yes please. I'll draft a one-paragraph pre-read + 3-bullet health summary and ping the CS lead for approval. Target: Monday EOD.

Priya (CS): Agreed. Action items: 1) onboarding-bot -> calendar + doc (done). 2) María -> pre-read draft (due Mon EOD). 3) Ethan -> finalize checklist slides (due Tue noon). 4) Notes -> volunteer? If no volunteers I'll ask Jules to cover handback. Meeting run order (short):

```
- 0:00 roll call & objective (2m)
- 0:02 demo highlight (10m)
- 0:12 onboarding checklist (8m)
- 0:20 renewal health + flags (6m)
- 0:26 quick action items & next steps (4m)
```

Jules: I can take notes and do the handback if nobody else steps up. I'll be on mute for the demo but can unmute for Qs.

Priya (CS): Amazing — that's everything. I'll post the invite and the pre-read deadline reminder in #customer-success-channel tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone :rocket:
